issues.description: pipeline.py change from empty-string to 'python:3.12' silently overrides KFP's own default resolution.
issues.detail: Previously base_image='' signaled 'let KFP choose its default'. The new code forces 'python:3.12', collapsing 'unspecified' and a concrete tag into one value. The comment above still says 'Use kfp default image'. This is a real behavior change for every caller relying on the empty-string contract. Restore '' or explicitly migrate callers and update the comment.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant duplicated across Python, TS constant, TS fallback, and Jinja template.
issues.detail: The whole point of get_default_base_image RPC was to make this a single source of truth, but 'python:3.12' is now hardcoded in pipeline.py, CellMetadataEditor.tsx DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE, Commands.ts catch fallback, and the Jinja template chain. These copies will silently drift. Remove the TS literals; rely on the RPC value and render an explicit loading/unknown state on failure.

issues.description: Effective-image precedence chain reimplemented in 3+ sites with inconsistent ordering.
issues.detail: The chain 'step.base_image || pipeline.base_image || default || HARDCODED' appears in InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText, the Dialog placeholder, and the Jinja template, with subtly different ordering between Python and TS. This is one ADT operation duplicated across languages. Resolve once (ideally server-side in compiler.py via a named resolveBaseImage function) and pass a single resolved value down.

issues.description: Replacing inline Input with a modal Dialog is more framework for the same single text field.
issues.detail: The old UI was one Input bound to updateBaseImage. The new UI adds Dialog/DialogTitle/DialogContent/DialogActions, a baseImageDialogOpen state field, a modal lifecycle, and disables the button until stepName is set, all to surface one default string. A placeholder or helper label on the original Input would have achieved the same goal with zero new components.

issues.description: Three-level prop drilling for defaultBaseImage and pipelineBaseImage where context or a leaf fetch would suffice.
issues.detail: defaultBaseImage flows LeftPanel -> InlineCellsMetadata -> InlineMetadata and CellMetadataEditor, each hop adding an optional prop, a default, and a fallback chain ending in another hardcoded literal. A small context (already used for CellMetadata) or a single fetch in the editor would collapse this drilling.

issues.description: Button with width:'5%' labeled 'IMAGE' is fragile, context-dependent layout coupling.
issues.detail: A 5% width on a Button whose label is 'IMAGE' will clip, wrap, or overflow depending on parent container width, and the inline style competes with MUI Button sizing. The previous 25% Input was at least sized to its content domain. Either size by content (auto) or own the layout at the row level with a clearer label like 'Edit Base Image'.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus on two P0 issues: pipeline.py silently changes the semantics of base_image='' (delegate to KFP) to a hardcoded 'python:3.12', breaking existing callers and contradicting the adjacent comment; and the DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant is duplicated across four sites (Python, TS constant, TS fallback, Jinja template) despite the new RPC existing precisely to centralize it. The effective-image precedence chain is also reimplemented in multiple sites with inconsistent ordering. The UI regression — replacing a single Input with a modal Dialog — is judged 'easy-not-simple' framework overhead for a one-string field. Fix path: resolve the default once on the server, remove TS literals, restore inline editing, and keep '' semantics distinct from concrete tags.
